title: The Sun as a scalar wave generator sending information

tellings.quote: up in government seem to get behind, then maybe the sun is, it is a scalar wave generator. And then maybe we're getting information from the sun

plain: Michels muses that the Sun might be a scalar wave generator, scalar waves being a proposed kind of energy wave outside mainstream physics, and that we might be getting information from it. He offers this himself in a 2025 conversation with the philosopher James Madden, as an idea he says some people high up in government seem to get behind, and if true it would make the Sun a kind of source of messages.
